metadata.scenario: A returning client books a follow-up appointment for their ongoing physiotherapy treatment. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. Hi David, it's great to hear from you. How can I assist you today? I'm looking to arrange physical therapy and nursing care for my wife. She’s recovering from a stroke. Of course, I’m sorry to hear about your wife. We can definitely help with that. Can I ask if you have a specific schedule in mind for the appointments? We're looking for therapy sessions a couple of times a week, maybe Mondays and Thursdays? Sounds good. I can check our availability for those days. For physical therapy, our therapist, Dr. James Rodriguez, is available on those days. Great! What about nursing care? We have skilled nursing options available as well. Robert Davis is our registered nurse who specializes in recovery care. Perfect! Can I schedule both for Mondays and Thursdays then? Yes, absolutely. I’ll book Dr. Rodriguez for physical therapy and Robert for nursing care. Would you prefer morning or afternoon appointments? Mornings would work better for us, around 10 AM if possible. Let me confirm that... Yes, we can schedule both appointments for 10 AM. Dr. Rodriguez can come on Mondays and Robert can be there Thursdays at 10 AM. That sounds perfect, thank you! You're welcome, David! I will also send you a care plan for your review. That would be helpful, thanks! Just to confirm, the physical therapy will be $110-$140 per session, and nursing care is $95-$125 per visit. I appreciate the clarity on pricing. Is there anything else you would like to discuss or additional services you may need? Possibly companion care for her as well. We can definitely arrange that! Our companion care service is available at $25-$30 per hour. I’ll think about it and get back to you. No problem at all! I’ll follow up in a few days to check in. That sounds good. Thank you for your help, Margaret. Anytime, David! We look forward to working with you and your wife. Bye! Bye!
